data.long_meaning: The name 'Basudev' is derived from Sanskrit words 'BASU' meaning 'Lord' and 'DEV' meaning 'God'. This name represents the divine being who is the ruler and protector of all beings. The name Basudev carries the meaning “Lord of all beings” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Basudev usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of all beings and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Basudev holds immense spiritual significance in Hinduism as it signifies the presence of the divine within the self. The prefix 'BASU' represents the ultimate ruler or controller while the suffix 'DEV' signifies the deity or the divine presence. Thus, the name 'Basudev' serves as a reminder that the supreme consciousness or God is the true controller of our lives, and we are merely His devotees. It also signifies the state of being dedicated to and serving the divine. By invoking this name, one can seek the blessings of the divine, and strive to live a pious and virtuous life.
